title: ID0424524-DC/Si-D/MY-[MP / ND 170000121] Fail to perform software update
description: Reported behaviour/issue:  Sicharge D fail to perform software update via USB

additional_info.subject: SiD/MY/ MP ND 170000121: USB Firmware Update failure
additional_info.body:
Dear Helpdesk,
Sicharge D
Serial Number: MP / ND 170000121
Charger ID: sruJwD
Country: Malaysia
Current FW: V4.0.11
Problem statement:
Sicharge D fail to perform software update via USB
We are attempting to upgrade the Sicharge D from V4.0.11 to V5.0.23 using the SanDisk Flair USB 132GB
The charger is online all the time..
We had done the following: from 6pm to 730pm (GMT+8)
1) On site, plug into X50 -> failed
2) Plug into X51 -> failed
3) reformat USB and HDD burn again
4) Plug into X50 - failed
Attached is the log files where we saw the SWupdate was aborted.
Please kindly troubleshoot and let us know why the SWupdate is aborted as the USB was previously used to update the same charger.
Thank you
Edna
